'''Maylur''' was a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]] who served on the [[planet]] [[Eriadu]] and was responsible for the security of [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s compound, [[Raven's Peak]].<ref name="The Summit" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Maylur first appeared in "[[The Summit]]," the fifteenth episode of [[The Bad Batch Season 2|season two]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|The Bad Batch]]''. [[Alain Uy]] voiced the character.<ref name="The Summit" />
